subject.title: Bounded memory tool with hard character limits

question: Should OpenClaw add a memory-core bounded CRUD memory write tool now, and what hard-limit, config, duplicate/consolidation, snapshot, and secret-rejection contract should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix creates new user-facing memory-write and security policy rather than repairing a broken existing API.

options.title: Sponsor bounded CRUD in memory-core
options.body: Approve a memory-core design for add/list/replace/remove with hard budgets, usage feedback, duplicate/consolidation behavior, secret rejection, docs, and focused upgrade/security proof.

options.title: Limit scope to flush bounds
options.body: Treat the open daily-memory flush-bound work as the near-term mitigation while explicitly leaving general memory CRUD out of core for now.

options.title: Move write policy to an external memory plugin
options.body: Keep core recall-only and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package if current plugin APIs can safely enforce the desired hard memory limits.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded CRUD in memory-core
recommendation.body: Approve a memory-core design for add/list/replace/remove with hard budgets, usage feedback, duplicate/consolidation behavior, secret rejection, docs, and focused upgrade/security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security boundary choice and `steipete` is the strongest available maintainer-routing signal from the shallow local history and PR metadata.
